title: Book Two · Chapter 97: The Summer Work Basket
story:
At home, the summer work basket is almost full. Mum has agreed to several small jobs before the holiday. She will leave some afternoons free after those collections.

Ronan sits beside her with his school bag. He tells her about Miss Wu's booklet idea. Mum checks her customers' dates. Then she answers.

“After the holiday?”

“Yes. Next term.”

“Then you have time to decide.”

“I want to do it with Jun.”

“Has Jun agreed?”

“Not yet.”

Mum nods and ties a small paper to one clean bag. She gives the knot a gentle pull. Ronan watches the two ends fall into place.

“Can I come with you on a collection day?” he asks.

“One near here. Not all of them.”

“Can we go to the square after?”

“If the time suits us both.”

He takes out a pencil and writes square on a scrap. Mum looks at it.

“Not every afternoon,” she says.

“I know.”

Ronan has three holiday wishes. He wants more rides with Dad. He wants games with his friends. He also wants another reading visit. But that needs money and time. Mum listens to all three. She cannot promise a reading visit yet. His single morning long ago is still his only one.

He folds the scrap and puts it in his own book. He understands the difference now. The list has his wishes on it. Mum has not agreed to them. He still finds that annoying.

Later, a customer arrives early. Mum is not ready to give her the whole job. One part still needs a small change. She shows it and gives the agreed collection time again.

The woman asks if she can wait. Mum looks at the work, then at the clock.

“Not today. Please come at the time on your paper.”

After the woman leaves, Ronan asks why Mum did not hurry.

“Someone is waiting. But I still need to do the work carefully.”

Mum goes back to the cloth. Ronan brings her water and clears his book from the table. He has his own reading to finish before supper.

The black cat appears at the window. It puts one paw on the sill. Then it puts up another. Mum points toward the yard. Ronan goes to the door and calls softly. The cat looks at him. It stays at the window.

He puts his ball on the ground. The cat steps outside to look at it. Mum's clean work bag is nearby. Ronan picks up the ball. He does not let the cat push it inside.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

basket＝篮子；customer＝顾客；collection＝领取。

## 理解问题

1. Mum怎样安排暑假里的客户工作？
2. Ronan怎样提出自己的假期愿望？

## 读句子

**She / gives / the knot a gentle pull.** 她／轻轻地／拉一下绳结。
